review_score.definition: On-Time = sla_delay_days <= 0; SLA Breached = sla_delay_days > 0; reviewed delivered orders only

repeat_purchase.definition: first delivered order per customer_unique_id (customer_order_seq == 1); is_repeat_buyer = >= 2 delivered orders; is_repeat_within_180d_after_delivery = a new order placed within 180 days AFTER the first order was delivered (only first orders with >= 180 days of observable follow-up)

sla_threshold_discontinuity.design: Local comparison of orders delivered exactly on the promised date (Day 0) vs one day late (Day +1); the Day -1 vs Day 0 step is a placebo threshold where no SLA status changes.

model_1_severe_detractor.description: Customer experience: P(severe detractor review) on all reviewed delivered orders

prediction_spec.formula: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coefficients[f] * x[f] for f in feature_order))))

preprocessing.is_sla_breached: 1.0 if delay_days > 0 else 0.0 (binary breach flag; delay magnitude is not modelled)

model_2_repeat_buyer.description: Retention: P(customer ever places >= 2 delivered orders) given first-order SLA breach

prediction_spec.formula: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coefficients[f] * x[f] for f in feature_order))))

preprocessing.is_sla_breached: 1.0 if delay_days > 0 else 0.0 (binary breach flag; delay magnitude is not modelled)

model_2b_repeat_buyer_detractor_exposure.description: Retention sensitivity: exposure = first-order severe detractor review instead of SLA breach

prediction_spec.formula: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coefficients[f] * x[f] for f in feature_order))))

model_2c_repeat_within_180d_after_delive.description: Retention timing-clean sensitivity: new order within 180 days AFTER first delivery (first orders with a full 180-day follow-up window only)

prediction_spec.formula: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coefficients[f] * x[f] for f in feature_order))))

preprocessing.is_sla_breached: 1.0 if delay_days > 0 else 0.0 (binary breach flag; delay magnitude is not modelled)

model_1_fixed_effects_robustness.description: Model 1 + item_count + customer-state fixed effects + purchase-month fixed effects (purchase months 2017-01..2018-08)

seller_concentration.gini_method: 1 - 2 * trapezoid(cum_gmv_share, cum_seller_share), sellers ascending by GMV, [0,0] prepended

headline.sentence: Missing the promised delivery SLA date multiplies the odds of a severe detractor review (1–2 stars) by 16.3× (adjusted OR, 95% CI: [15.40, 17.25], p < 0.0001), while the top 18.6% of sellers generate 80% of platform GMV.
